test: SD1.4 held-out set (generate_diffusion_data.py::generate_holdout_test_set, n=30, seed_offset=90000, disjoint from train/val seed ranges)
caveat: Same-family test only (SD1.4 is already in the CNN members' training distribution after the diffusion-blindspot fix). Does NOT test generalization to generator families absent from training (Flux, Midjourney v7, SDXL, Firefly) -- that is the case CLIP was added for, and it is unverified pending access to sample images from those generators.
interpretation: CLIP member converted the one previously-abstained image to a correct answer, and roughly doubled mean member disagreement (still far under the 0.35 abstain threshold) -- consistent with it genuinely contributing a different perspective rather than just riding along on the CNNs' votes.
